# Max Zlydar — Product Designer

> Max Zlydar is a product designer with 7+ years of experience in B2B and B2C SaaS, fintech, iGaming and retail tech. He designs products end-to-end — user research, UX, UI, design systems and brand — and measures design decisions against business metrics. Open to new product design projects.

## Case studies

- [LuxBox — trust-first iGaming UX](https://maxzweb.github.io/portfolio/cases/case1.html): Mystery-box platform with real luxury prizes (watches, gold, sneakers), designed end-to-end for web and mobile in 2025. Role: Lead Product Designer (research, UX, UI, design system, brand) in a team of a founder, 3 developers and a marketer. Key decisions: transparent odds on every box, live drops, battles and ranks for retention, a regional fallback for legal restrictions. Reported results: +12% visit → first box opened, −25% odds-related support tickets, boxes opened per user per month 3.1 → 3.5.
- [Space Planning — B2B retail SaaS UX](https://maxzweb.github.io/portfolio/cases/case2.html): Planogram platform for grocery retail (client: OmniOptimise), designed over two years (2024–2025). Role: Senior Product Designer. Turned shelf planning from a specialist task into a routine for store office staff with no planning background: guided shelf editor, in-place validation, quick tips, financial reports and a design system. Retail clients of the platform report +5–10% revenue in target categories, −5% inventory days on hand, +18% gross margin at 7-Eleven Philippines, shelf space utilisation up from 90% to 96%, first store-level plans in under 2 weeks (down from 20+), ~10k store-level planograms created weekly.
